body: Fix spec android-macos-e2e-fixes: MB1 and H1 root causes, confirmed by widget test and probe at d36b748.U+000AU+000AShared mechanism, from the investigation: an open OverlayPortal's overlay is placed in reading order under its anchor's nearest node (the traversal parent). When that node is detached (blocked, clipped away by a lazy list, or excluded), the overlay is listed by no parent in reading order. Android then drops the subtree. The macOS ax tree rejects the whole update ("will not be in the tree and is not the new root", accessibility_bridge.cc:108-116), so the previous screen's tree stays. Widget tests walk the hit-test tree only, which is why the sweep missed it.U+000AU+000ADraft test docs/specs/android-macos-e2e-fixes.repro.dart compares nodes reachable in hit-test order with nodes reachable in reading order. Run in the probe worktree as test/repro/android_macos_e2e_fixes_repro_test.dart:U+000AU+002D H1: with the month picker open, nothing is labelled in reading order (it expected 'Dismiss month picker' and got []). The sweep's a5 state orphans every month node. Cause: BlockSemantics around the portal overlay (calendar_screen.dart:246) blocks the whole route, including the portal's own anchor.U+000AU+002D MB1: an unlabelled node is orphaned in Settings whenever the Text size row sits just past the list's cache edge. With no scroll, that happens at window heights 840 to 880; other heights hit it at scroll offsets. Probe: swapping Material Slider in SettingsSlider for an overlay-free node makes the test pass. So Material Slider's always-open OverlayPortal (slider.dart:680-683) is the orphan source.U+000AU+002D The other 47 sweep states have no orphans.U+000AU+002D Other portals at risk: More formats (format_bar.dart:347), the photo toolbar menu, and the log actions pill.U+000AU+002D Not yet observed: the macOS engine log line itself (that needs a live launch).
